design_philosophy.emotional_goal: Evoke nostalgia and excitement without being cringe

layout_structure.app_container: min-h-screen w-full bg-[#7F1D1D] relative overflow-hidden flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-4
layout_structure.card_container: w-full max-w-md bg-[#FDFBF7] rounded-xl shadow-2xl relative overflow-hidden min-h-[600px] flex flex-col
layout_structure.overlay_texture: absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none opacity-10 bg-[url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1617565085015-13cb9d366120?crop=entropy&cs=srgb&fm=jpg&ixid=M3w4NjA1ODh8MHwxfHNlYXJjaHwxfHxjcnVtcGxlZCUyMHdoaXRlJTIwcGFwZXIlMjB0ZXh0dXJlfGVufDB8fHx8MTc3MDkxNDkwOXww&ixlib=rb-4.1.0&q=85')] bg-cover mix-blend-multiply

buttons.primary: bg-[#E11D48] text-white hover:bg-[#BE123C] rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium transition-all transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 shadow-lg
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border-2 border-[#E11D48] text-[#E11D48] hover:bg-[#FFF1F2] rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium transition-all
buttons.ghost: text-[#57534E] hover:text-[#1C1917] hover:bg-black/5 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 transition-colors

inputs.text: bg-transparent border-b-2 border-[#A8A29E] focus:border-[#E11D48] px-0 py-2 outline-none w-full text-xl font-medium text-[#1C1917] placeholder:text-[#A8A29E] transition-colors
inputs.select: w-full bg-white border border-[#E5E7EB] rounded-lg px-4 py-3 text-[#1C1917] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E11D48] focus:border-transparent outline-none

principles: No laggy animations - use transform/opacity only

transitions.page_transition: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -20 }} transition={{ duration: 0.4, ease: 'easeOut' }}

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text on red brick background has shadow or overlay. Use WCAG AA standards.
accessibility.aria: All interactive elements must have aria-labels if icon-only.

testing.requirement: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes

instructions_to_main_agent: SETUP: Add the Google Fonts link to the head of index.html immediately.
LAYOUT: Wrap the main app in a container that applies the Red Brick background image with a dark overlay for readability.
COMPONENT: Create a reusable 'NotebookCard' component that acts as the main white paper container.
STYLE: Use 'Caveat' font for all H1, H2 headers and 'Love Lab' branding. Use 'DM Sans' for body text and form inputs.
MICRO-INTERACTION: Add a subtle 'heart float' animation when a user selects an answer.
CRITICAL: Ensure the app is mobile-responsive. The card should take up most of the screen on mobile but have padding on desktop.
DATA: Mock the backend calls for now, but structure the data aggregation logic clearly.
MODERATION: Implement a simple bad-word filter list for the confession wall.
IMAGES: Use the provided texture URLs for backgrounds. Do not use placeholders.
